encoding.default_number_chart: WP06 §1.3. required: the keys the new Number widget's chart map (layout_settings["3"]) must hold after the seed, compared by value (a native integer equals the same JS number). parsed: what every reader parses from that map, in the persisted snake_case shape; number_format is the numberFormat key, title_text the titleText key, and y_field_id null means no Y field (desktop reads it as ""). Writers may add other default keys (desktop also writes x_field_id, y_field_id, cumulative and titleText); the raw map bytes are not compared.
encoding.default_widget_spec: WP06 §1.2. resolveDefaultWidgetSpec({chart_creation_allowed, number_chart_allowed}) -> expect {layout, name}: a Number chart named "Chart" only when both are allowed, else a Grid view named "Table" (the picker label of the Grid layout).
encoding.picker_sections: WP06 §1.4, WP05 §1.9. buildWidgetPickerSections(input) for one picker state. input: the host (primary) database and its views in host order (embedded views are offered only when host_tab_view_ids lists them, or when this dashboard owns them; host_tab_view_ids null means every view is a tab), owned = view id -> owning dashboard view id (absent = not owned), the catalog of the other workspace databases in catalog order (views with is_container are never offered; the host's catalog entry is skipped: the host is listed from its live doc), the search query, whether Other data sources is expanded, the database ids whose Show more was clicked, the Timeline and Chart creation states (enabled, disabled = shown but not selectable, hidden = not listed) and whether a view can be created in another database. Never offered: the dashboard view, the flow's own default view, Dashboard layouts, views owned by another dashboard. Search: normalizeDashboardText (text-normalize.json) of the query is a substring of the view name, its database name or a new view type label (picker_layout_labels). expect.host: null when the section has no rows, else its title ("Views on {name}", "Views on this database" without a name), the listed view ids and the hidden count behind Show {n} more (first 5 per group; no truncation for a non-empty query or a database in show_all). expect.other: expanded (clicked or a non-empty query) and its groups in catalog order (database id, name, view ids, more, whether the trailing New view in {database} row shows); empty groups are left out. expect.new_view: the New view rows in Notion order, new_view_disabled the ones listed but not selectable. expect.no_results: a non-empty query matched nothing.
encoding.picker_layout_labels: The English label of each New view row, matched by the search (clients use their translated label).
encoding.docked_popover_side: WP06 §1.6. dockedPopoverSide(anchor_right_x, viewport_right_x, width = 300, gap = 8, padding = 16): right when anchor_right_x + gap + width <= viewport_right_x - padding, else left. The anchor is the widget box's top-right corner; the picker, the New view panel and the widget settings host all use it.
encoding.flow: WP06 §1.5. reduceAddWidgetFlow(state, event) -> {state, effects}, applied to the events in order starting from {kind: idle}; expect_states[i] and expect_effects[i] follow events[i]. The start event carries what the client resolved before it: the placement, the pre-generated widget id, the default spec (chart or grid, default_widget_spec) and refused (the canAddDashboardWidget verdict: null, dashboard or row). States: idle; creating {widget_id, placement, spec, popover_open}; open, configuring and settings {widget_id, view_id, layout, auto_named} (settings also back_to). auto_named stays true until the user renames the view; rename_if_auto is only emitted while it is true, and the client renames the view to nextViewName(label of layout, the database's other view names). A start while creating is ignored (one add at a time). Effects are objects keyed by type; layouts use the layout names of picker_sections.
